purpose: Prevent lane drift, duplicate ownership, completion confusion, and loss of program continuity while current systems and work programs are being finished and integrated into System Master.
global_rules: Each active peer system owns and executes only its assigned product job plus explicit admitted interfaces to System Master.
Named non-peer work programs keep their own semantic work scope and evidence continuity but do not acquire peer topology, canonical owner-lane or Second Shift authority merely from this job lock.

The Book-Prose parent/child relationship is the only direct specialist cross-lane relationship authorized by this lock. Prose executes under BOOK lane control and has no independent peer/Second Shift lane.

Peer systems may integrate upward into SYSTEM_MASTER through explicit interfaces, but may not take another peer's implementation, semantic authority, current objective, completion state, repair lane, or canonical writes.
SYSTEM_MASTER/CORE may provide shared infrastructure and integration surfaces but may not silently implement or own Learning, Book, Prose, Documents, or Programming-specific engineering semantics.

Completed Prose evidence and semantics are preserved. Adapters/orchestrator integration around Prose does not make Book complete and does not reopen Prose feature development absent demonstrated defect or explicit user direction.
A packet/phase/test closure never means the owning system or work program is complete unless its applicable completion authority says so.
Second Shift, repair, morning startup, obligation selection, owner chats, and work-program chats must reject work that violates these job boundaries.

SYSTEM_MASTER.job: Integrate CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, and DOCUMENTS into one coherent product; maintain product architecture, sequencing, interface boundaries, and cross-system acceptance without taking their product ownership.
forbidden: declare child systems complete without product-level authority
create duplicate peer systems from chats/branches/workstreams

CORE.job: Finish shared Foundation and Spine plus shared runtime/data/platform/continuity/assurance/A-01 infrastructure and Master-facing integration primitives.
forbidden: reclassify Programming-specific engineering semantics as generic Core product work

LEARNING.job: Finish Learning product behavior, curriculum/compiler, mastery/assessment/adaptation/evidence, then integrate Learning upward into System Master through explicit interfaces.
forbidden: cross into Book or Prose work
redefine Core shared contracts instead of consuming them

BOOK.job: Finish the Book system. Integrate the completed Prose child into Book through adapters and the Book Workflow Orchestrator; preserve Book canonical manuscript/Story Bible/author/lifecycle/admission/publication ownership; then integrate Book upward into System Master.
forbidden: declare Book complete before the full Book product completion boundary
cross into Learning or Programming product work

PROSE.job: Operate as the completed literary specialist beneath Book. Provide Prose analysis, craft intelligence, diagnosis, revision candidates, evaluation support, voice/preservation and homogenization-defense capabilities through Book-controlled adapters/orchestration.
forbidden: feature-scope expansion without demonstrated defect or explicit user direction

DOCUMENTS.job: Finish Documents product behavior for DOCX/PDF/PPTX/general document artifact structure, conversion, preservation, rendering/export and generic document services, then integrate Documents upward into System Master.

PROGRAMMING.job: Continue the existing Programming software-engineering program from preserved foundation/capability/build/test/assurance evidence; recover only missing exact source/custody evidence; complete only material current deltas; keep Programming semantics isolated from Core, Learning, Book, Prose and Documents; and prepare explicit System Master integration/admission without silently promoting Programming to a peer system.
forbidden: restart completed Programming foundation work from scratch
silently promote Programming to peer topology
create a Programming peer Second Shift lane before admission
allow another lane to absorb Programming-specific engineering semantics

PROGRAMMING_KNOWLEDGE_RECOVERY.job: Recover exact Programming assets/custody/provenance and prepare reusable evidence without replacing the Programming engineering program, changing current product topology, or taking priority over independent system work unless selected for a bounded dependency.

lane_crossing_policy.direct_specialist_exception: BOOK <-> PROSE only, because Prose is Book's child specialist.
lane_crossing_policy.peer_integration_rule: CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, and DOCUMENTS remain in their own lanes. Their only cross-system product integration is through explicit System Master/shared-service interfaces; ownership never crosses with the call.
lane_crossing_policy.programming_rule: PROGRAMMING is a named active work program with isolated engineering semantics and preserved evidence continuity. Until explicit topology admission it does not own a peer lane, and no peer lane may absorb its product semantics.
lane_crossing_policy.documents_prose_rule: DOCUMENTS must not absorb, schedule, repair, or claim Book-specific PROSE work.
lane_crossing_policy.learning_rule: LEARNING remains fully isolated from BOOK/PROSE/DOCUMENTS/PROGRAMMING product work except shared System Master interfaces.
lane_crossing_policy.core_rule: CORE supplies shared primitives and product-root integration support; it does not become the implementation owner of peer systems or the Programming work program.
